strategies.name: Synthetic Long / Short Stock (Combo)

legs.strike_rule: K = ATM, same strike for both legs (short version: short call)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: long: S_T - K - D, where D = C - P (negative = credit). Short: K - S_T + D, where D = C - P is the credit received
strategies.max_profit: long: unbounded. Short: K + D (at S_T = 0)
strategies.max_loss: long: K + D (at S_T = 0; OIC: substantial). Short: unbounded
strategies.breakevens: S_T = K + D for both (OIC: strike + net debit, or strike - net credit)

greeks_at_inception.delta: + e^{-qT} (~+1) for the long, ~-1 for the short (European parity: delta_C - delta_P = e^{-qT})

strategies.when_to_use: Capital-light stock exposure (margin on the short put instead of the full stock price); short exposure when the borrow is hard or expensive; conversion/reversal arbitrage when C - P deviates from S - K*exp(-rT) - PV(div).
strategies.risks: Full stock risk; early assignment of the short leg (ex-dividend for calls, deep ITM for puts) breaks the parity position; no dividends or votes (OIC); financing is embedded in D.
strategies.margin_note: Reg T: short-option margin (premium + 20% - OTM) plus the long option paid; far below 50% stock Reg T. Portfolio margin treats it as stock. Deribit: BTC margin on the short leg. CME: a synthetic on ES/GC options vs the future.
strategies.crypto_notes: On Deribit the synthetic equals an inverse future at K, paying (S_T-K)/S_T BTC; its price vs the dated future reveals the options' implied forward (basis = funding/carry). No dividends; it can be marked 24/7 against the perp funding rate.
strategies.metals_notes: A GC call minus a GC put at K is a synthetic GC future; it should price to the actual GC future, apart from the American early-exercise premium, and SPAN margin for the pair is tiny. A GLD synthetic carries GLD's expense ratio instead of storage cost.
strategies.claim: In captured SPX (European), SPY, GLD and IBIT chains, the mid-price synthetic forward K + C - P deviates from the parity forward by more than the two half-spreads plus 10 bps of spot in fewer than 1% of near-ATM strike-expiry pairs (no exploitable conversion/reversal edge for a retail API account).

trial.statistic: share of pairs with |K + C_mid - P_mid - F| > half-spread(C) + half-spread(P) + 0.001*S, where F = S*exp((r-q)T) for SPX, and for American SPY/GLD/IBIT the check is against the American no-arbitrage bounds S - PV(div) - K <= C - P <= S - K*exp(-rT)
trial.procedure: for each daily capture, take the 3 strikes nearest spot for every expiry; r from FRED DTB3; q for SPX/SPY implied from the SPX box/parity regression (dividends are not in the free data list); cluster CIs by capture day
trial.data: CBOE delayed chains for _SPX, SPY, GLD, IBIT (daily capture from 2026-10-14); DTB3
trial.pass: share < 1% with a day-clustered 95% CI entirely below 1%
trial.controls: Delayed (15-min) quotes can be stale: exclude crossed or zero bids. SPX is the clean European control. The repo's T-181 parity_check (mandel/experiments/options_market.py) already regresses C - P on K: run both.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture, about 5 trading days. One capture already gives about 250 near-ATM pairs (SPY/GLD/IBIT/SPX have dozens of expiries each), so 500 pairs come quickly, but at least 5 separate days are needed for a day-clustered CI. Not 20 days.

strategies.name: ZEBRA (Zero Extrinsic Back Ratio)

legs.strike_rule: K1 = ITM, delta ~0.70 (chosen so 2 x extrinsic(K1) ~ extrinsic(K2)); put ZEBRA: 2 ITM puts
K2 = ATM (put ZEBRA: short 1 ATM put)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: 2*max(S_T-K1,0) - max(S_T-K2,0) - D, where D = 2C(K1) - C(K2) ~ 2(S-K1) (near-zero net extrinsic)
strategies.max_profit: unbounded (S_T - K2 + 2(K2-K1) - D above K2, i.e. 1:1 with the stock)
strategies.max_loss: D, for S_T <= K1
strategies.breakevens: S_T = K1 + D/2 if this is <= K2 (with zero extrinsic, D = 2(S-K1) gives S_T = S); otherwise S_T = D - 2K1 + K2... in general, solve 2(S_T-K1) = D on [K1,K2]

greeks_at_inception.theta: ~0 (net extrinsic ~0; BS at 70-delta leaves about 0.25% of spot of net extrinsic at 30 DTE)

strategies.when_to_use: Stock-replacement with a defined loss and almost no time-value bill: 1:1 upside above K2, losses that decelerate below K2 and stop at K1.
strategies.risks: Below K2 the position loses at twice the stock's rate down to K1 (about 2x delta exposure on small dips); bid-ask on ITM strikes; early assignment of the short ATM call before ex-dividend.
strategies.margin_note: Debit paid; the short call is covered by a long call, so no extra Reg T margin. Deribit/CME: net long options.
strategies.crypto_notes: On Deribit inverse settlement turns the 1:1 USD upside into a BTC payoff that saturates as S rises; the zero-extrinsic strike depends on the BTC smile (both wings rich), so solve it from the book.
strategies.metals_notes: A GLD or GC call ZEBRA replaces a long gold position with a defined loss and no storage cost; GC legs are American.

trial.statistic: mean of (ZEBRA P&L - delta_0 x SPY P&L)/S with block bootstrap CI
trial.procedure: monthly cycles; solve the 0.70-delta strike at VIX IV; payoff from the SPY close; the cash difference earns DTB3
trial.data: SPY, VIX, DTB3
trial.pass: upper CI < 0
trial.controls: The net extrinsic paid (about 0.25% of S per month under flat pricing) is the cost tested against the convexity gained. Flat IV misprices the ITM call wing; rerun on chain mids at 60 days.

strategies.name: Zero-DTE Directional Debit Spread

legs.strike_rule: K1 = ATM (bear version: long ATM put)
legs.expiry_rule: 0 DTE (SPXW, XSP, SPY, QQQ, IWM, GLD, IBIT daily expiries; SPXW trading ceases 4:00 pm ET)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: min(max(S_T-K1,0), K2-K1) - D, settled on the same day's close for PM-settled SPXW
strategies.max_loss: D
strategies.breakevens: S_T = K1 + D

greeks_at_inception.gamma: very + near K1, very - near K2 (intraday gamma is the whole trade)
greeks_at_inception.theta: - extreme (the whole extrinsic value decays by the close)

strategies.when_to_use: Intraday directional view (open drive, post-event, FOMC afternoon) with a hard-capped loss; 1256 tax on SPX/XSP; defined risk replaces a stop order that could gap.
strategies.risks: Binary outcome by the close; bid-ask is a large share of the premium; per the Bandi-Fusari-Reno seminar abstract, 0DTE volume reached over 45% of daily option volume in 2023, with pricing shaped by jumps and intraday vol-of-vol; pin risk around strikes into the close; SPY/QQQ/GLD/IBIT versions are American and physically settled, with after-close exercise risk (SPX is cash-settled with no assignment).
strategies.margin_note: Debit paid in full. SPX/XSP: cash-settled, European, no early assignment, Section 1256 60/40 (the XSP page states 60/40). Deribit daily expiries at 08:00 UTC play the same role.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit lists daily BTC expiries (verified today: 15, 16, 17, 18 Oct 2026 at 08:00 UTC). The 0DTE equivalent settles to the 30-min index TWAP into 08:00 UTC, so the 'close' is a TWAP, not a print. A 0.0003 BTC/contract commission matters at tiny premiums. IBIT has daily equity-option expiries (today's capture lists Mon-Fri expiries), a US-hours alternative.
strategies.metals_notes: Correction: today's CBOE capture shows GLD with daily (Mon-Fri) expiries and SLV with Mon/Wed/Fri expiries, so GLD 0DTE exists every weekday. GC futures options have several weekly expiries per week; the exact days were not verified (CME pages return 403 here).
strategies.claim: An SPX 0DTE ATM/+0.5% bull call spread bought at the mid at a fixed intraday capture time and held to the 4:00 pm settlement has a mean return per dollar of debit <= 0 after one half-spread per leg, over 120 or more sessions.

trial.statistic: mean return on debit after half-spread costs, studentized bootstrap CI over sessions
trial.procedure: at each fixed-time intraday capture, record the same-day SPXW ATM and ATM + 0.5% call bid/ask; debit = mid difference; settle at the SPX close; subtract one half-spread per leg
trial.data: CBOE delayed _SPX chain (today's capture includes the same-day 2026-10-14 expiry) captured at a fixed intraday time, SPX close
trial.pass: upper CI <= 0
trial.controls: Capture time fixed in advance. Delayed (15-min) quotes are a known stale-quote bias: record the SPX level at capture and discard sessions where SPX moved > 0.3% during the delay. Also run the mirror bear put spread. The existing daily capture job must run intraday (before 4 pm), not after the close, or same-day expiries will already be gone.

strategies.blocked_on: intraday (fixed-time, before 4 pm ET) 0DTE chain capture, 120 sessions
strategies.harness_suggestion: zero_dte_spread_study(symbol='_SPX', side='call', width=0.005) over the chain archive; add a Deribit daily-expiry twin settled on the 08:00 UTC TWAP

strategies.name: 0DTE SPX iron condor in positive dealer-gamma regime

legs.strike_rule: K1 = spot - 1.0% (about 10-15 delta at 10:00 ET when VIX is 15-20)
K2 = spot - 0.6% (about 20-30 delta at 10:00 ET when VIX is 15-20)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Cr + max(K1-S,0) - max(K2-S,0) - max(S-K3,0) + max(S-K4,0) at 4pm ET cash settlement.
strategies.max_profit: Cr if K2 <= S_T <= K3.
strategies.max_loss: (K2-K1) - Cr = (K4-K3) - Cr (equal 0.4% wings).
strategies.breakevens: K2 - Cr and K3 + Cr.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: negative, growing sharply into the afternoon
greeks_at_inception.vega: slightly negative (0DTE vega is small; realised move dominates)

strategies.when_to_use: Non-event days (no FOMC/CPI/NFP/opex) when the prior close's estimated SPX dealer gamma is positive and the overnight gap is small. Cboe reports 59% of SPX volume is 0DTE. Enter after the opening range (9:45-10:30), hold to settlement or close at 50% of credit. For 10-15-delta shorts instead, strikes sit near +/-1.0-1.2%.
strategies.risks: A 1% intraday trend day gives max loss, several times the credit; positive-GEX regimes end abruptly; last-30-minute liquidity; cash settlement removes assignment risk, not loss.
strategies.margin_note: Margin = wing width - credit (SPX $100 multiplier; XSP 1/10). Section 1256. European, no early exercise.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit daily options (settlement_period day, 08:00 UTC) allow the same structure on BTC/ETH; no GEX dataset, but public/get_book_summary_by_currency gives OI per instrument for a dealer-gamma proxy; per-leg fees are large relative to tiny 0DTE premiums.
strategies.metals_notes: No daily-expiry GLD equivalent on most days; use the nearest GC short-dated weekly or GLD weekly (check current CME/OCC listings). SPAN nets the condor.
variants: Put-side only (bull put spread) on positive-GEX up-drift days
Close at 50% credit vs hold to settlement
strategies.claim: A 0DTE SPXW iron condor sold at 10:00 ET with shorts at +/-0.6% and wings at +/-1.0% has a higher mean return on max loss on days when the prior-close estimated dealer gamma is positive than on days when it is negative.

trial.statistic: Mean return on max loss by GEX sign, difference with bootstrap CI; hit rate; CVaR; overall mean after fees.
trial.procedure: Prior-close chain captures give OI and Greeks -> GEX estimate; a 10:00 ET SPXW snapshot gives entry credit; SPX 4pm close gives settlement.
trial.data: SPX chain captures (prior close OI + 10:00 ET snapshot), SPX daily close; accumulating from 2026-10-14.
trial.pass: GEX-sign difference > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 over >= 120 trading days.
trial.controls: Shuffle GEX labels; exclude event days; 'sell every day' baseline; fee sensitivity.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture (~120 trading days) plus an added 10:00 ET SPXW snapshot; GEX estimator.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Second intraday SPX chain capture at 10:00 ET; GEX estimator; 0DTE P&L via settlement price.

strategies.name: 0DTE SPX long straddle on negative dealer-gamma / event days

legs.expiry_rule: same-day SPXW (0DTE), entered at the open or 13:55 ET before a 14:00 release

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: |S_T - K| - D at 4pm ET settlement; often gamma-scalped intraday (delta-hedged with ES/SPY at fixed thresholds) rather than held.
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited upside; K - D downside.
strategies.max_loss: D (all premium if S_T = K).
strategies.breakevens: K - D and K + D; at the open D is about 0.8*sigma_day*S with sigma_day about VIX/sqrt(252) (about 0.8% of spot at VIX 16).
strategies.when_to_use: When estimated dealer gamma is negative (hedging amplifies trends), after a >1% gap, or on 14:00 ET events (FOMC) bought at 13:55. Needs realised open-to-close (or 14:00-16:00) move > D.
strategies.risks: On ordinary days the 0DTE straddle loses most of its value (large 0DTE variance premium); OI-based GEX is noisy; gamma-scalping needs execution infrastructure; FOMC presser reversals can net to zero by 4pm.
strategies.margin_note: Debit only; Section 1256 for SPX/XSP.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit daily BTC/ETH straddles expiring 08:00 UTC. Event-day convexity example: BTC DVOL's daily candle on 2025-10-10 opened 39.7 and printed a 64.9 high (Deribit public DVOL data). Coin-settled payoff converts back to the vanilla USD payoff at S_T; hedge coin premium delta separately.
strategies.metals_notes: Nearest: GC short-dated weekly straddle bought before 8:30 ET NFP/CPI; GLD weeklies.
variants: Buy 13:55 ET on FOMC days only
strategies.claim: A 0DTE ATM SPXW straddle bought at 10:00 ET and held to settlement has a positive mean return on debit on days when the prior-close estimated dealer gamma is negative.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit by GEX sign, bootstrap CI; share of days with |move| > implied.
trial.procedure: GEX from prior-close chain captures; entry debit from a 10:00 ET snapshot; settlement from the 4pm SPX close; stratify by GEX sign and event flag. Interim proxy (MODEL-PRICED, no GEX): unconditional 1-day straddle at VIX-as-IV using SPY closes.
trial.data: SPX chain captures + SPX daily close; VIX for proxy pricing.
trial.pass: Negative-GEX mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 (expect roughly 30-40 negative-GEX days in 120).
trial.controls: Shuffle GEX; event-day exclusion; compare with the unconditional 0DTE straddle (expected negative).

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture (~120+ trading days, more if negative-GEX days are rare) for GEX plus a 10:00 ET snapshot.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Share the GEX estimator and 10:00 ET snapshot with the condor; report by GEX sign and event flag.

strategies.name: Binary-catalyst strangle vs condor (FDA PDUFA, court rulings, merger votes)

legs.strike_rule: Kc OTM 25-30% (PDUFA implied moves are often 30-60%)
legs.expiry_rule: first monthly expiry after the PDUFA/ruling date

legs.strike_rule: Kp OTM 40-50% (failures fall 50-80%; put wing further out than the call wing)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: max(S_T-Kc,0) + max(Kp-S_T,0) - D. Bimodal underlying: approval +30-80%, rejection/CRL -40-80%; pays in both modes if the wings sit inside them.
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited upside; Kp - D downside.
strategies.max_loss: D (decision delayed with the stock between the wings, or a muted move).
strategies.breakevens: Kp - D and Kc + D.

greeks_at_inception.delta: slightly positive (the farther-OTM put has smaller |delta| than the nearer call)
greeks_at_inception.gamma: positive but small until the final days

strategies.when_to_use: When the option-implied approval probability (solve p from a two-point mixture fitted to the chain) diverges from an independent estimate (trial data, advisory committee vote, Polymarket/Kalshi contract). Buy the strangle when the implied bimodal spread is narrower than history; sell an iron condor ONLY if a delay is expected. Never sell naked strangles on PDUFA names.
strategies.risks: Full premium lost if the FDA delays; hard-to-borrow stocks make puts very expensive; halts around the announcement; 10-20% spreads; the condor variant has catastrophic risk on a 70% move.
strategies.margin_note: Debit. Condor variant margin = width - credit, and the realistic loss is the max.
strategies.crypto_notes: Analogues: SEC enforcement outcomes or court rulings for BTC/ETH on Deribit; for a true binary, Polymarket/Kalshi event contracts are the cleaner instrument.
strategies.metals_notes: No scheduled binary analogue for gold/silver; tariff/sanction announcements are unscheduled.
variants: Risk reversal when independent approval probability > implied
Pair with a Polymarket/Kalshi binary to hedge the mode and keep the magnitude bet
strategies.claim: For FDA PDUFA dates on small-cap biotechs, a 25%/45%-OTM asymmetric strangle bought 5 trading days before the date and sold at the first open after a decision (or at the date +1 close if delayed) has a positive mean return on debit, delays included.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit with delays included; hit rate; decided-only mean reported separately; bootstrap CI.
trial.procedure: Build a PDUFA calendar (company 8-Ks/press releases; FDA describes the review process but publishes no calendar); chain captures for the strangle marks; daily OHLC for the move; walk-forward on an implied-probability filter.
trial.data: PDUFA/ruling calendar; chain captures; single-name OHLC; Polymarket/Kalshi odds where listed.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 including delays.
trial.controls: Random biotech non-event windows; XBI-adjusted moves; exclude large-cap pharma; calibration of implied vs realised approval rate as a diagnostic.

strategies.blocked_on: PDUFA calendar history + chain captures across >= 80 decisions (roughly 12 months).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Bimodal implied-distribution fitter (two-point mixture) from the chain; comparator with Polymarket/Kalshi odds.

strategies.name: Crude-oil scheduled-event straddle (OPEC+ meetings / EIA inventory)

legs.strike_rule: ATM (CL options on the front future, or USO); flip to SHORT when OVX-implied event move > 1.2x trailing realised event move
legs.expiry_rule: nearest weekly CL option expiring after the event (or USO weekly)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Long: |F_T - K| - D (CL options exercise into the CL future). Short: Cr - |F_T - K|.
strategies.max_profit: Long: unlimited upside; K - D downside. Short: Cr.
strategies.max_loss: Long: D. Short: unlimited upside; K - Cr downside.
strategies.breakevens: K - premium and K + premium.
strategies.when_to_use: OPEC+ ministerial meetings (dated, sometimes moved), weekly EIA petroleum status report (Wednesday 10:30 ET). Gate with OVX (Cboe crude oil ETF vol index, from USO options) or the event straddle vs trailing realised event moves.
strategies.risks: OPEC+ meetings get rescheduled or pre-leaked; CL options exercise into futures; physical-delivery roll around expiry; negative-price tail events (2020-04).
strategies.margin_note: CL options: SPAN, Section 1256. USO options: equity options, not 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: No direct analogue.
strategies.metals_notes: Same harness as GLD/GVZ; run gold and crude together on FOMC/CPI to separate macro from commodity-specific events.
strategies.claim: On OPEC+ ministerial meeting days since 2009-09, a 1-day ATM USO straddle model-priced with OVX-as-IV (sigma = OVX at the T-1 close, T = 1/252) and bought at the T-1 close has a higher mean P&L than on non-event days.

trial.statistic: Difference in mean MODEL-PRICED long-straddle P&L (event minus non-event), bootstrap CI.
trial.null: Event-day mean P&L <= non-event mean P&L.
trial.procedure: OVX CSV (free, since 2009-09) and USO closes (free, not wired); OPEC+ meeting dates hardcoded from OPEC press releases; EIA Wednesdays as a second event set.
trial.data: Cboe OVX history, USO daily closes, OPEC+ meeting calendar, EIA release calendar.
trial.pass: Difference > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: USO roll-date exclusion; 2020-03/04 exclusion; non-event Wednesdays for EIA.

strategies.blocked_on: USO closes and OVX history fetchers (both free, not in the current data list) and an OPEC+ meeting calendar.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Add (USO, OVX) to the (underlying, vol index) event harness.

strategies.name: Crypto macro-event straddle on Deribit (FOMC / CPI): DVOL vs realised

legs.strike_rule: ATM (nearest USD strike to the Deribit index); flip to LONG when the DVOL-implied event move < trailing realised FOMC-day move
legs.expiry_rule: BTC/ETH daily option expiring 08:00 UTC the morning after the 14:00 ET statement (about 14h after it in EDT, 13h in EST), or the weekly containing it

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Coin-settled: BTC payoff max(S_T-K,0)/S_T (call) and max(K-S_T,0)/S_T (put); converted at S_T this equals the vanilla USD payoff, so USD P&L of the short = Cr_usd - |S_T-K| (with Cr fixed in BTC, so its USD value also moves with S_T). S_T = Deribit index averaged over the 30 minutes before 08:00 UTC.
strategies.max_profit: Short: Cr (in coin). Long: unlimited in USD on the call (capped at 1 BTC per contract in coin terms); put up to K-D in USD (unbounded in coin terms as S_T->0).
strategies.max_loss: Short: unlimited upside in USD (capped at 1 BTC per call contract in coin); downside K-Cr in USD, but unbounded in coin terms as S_T->0, and coin collateral loses USD value at the same time. Long: D.
strategies.breakevens: K - premium and K + premium in USD-equivalent (premium valued at S_T).

greeks_at_inception.delta: approx 0 option delta; coin premium/collateral adds long-coin delta equal to the coin balance (short perp/future to neutralise for USD accounting)

strategies.when_to_use: Scheduled macro releases that move BTC/ETH: IM from the daily straddle (or DVOL/sqrt(365)*sqrt(h/24)) vs trailing 12 same-event realised moves; sell when IM/HM > 1.2, buy when < 0.8. 24/7 trading makes the 14:00 ET statement tradable live; options expire only at 08:00 UTC.
strategies.risks: Deribit liquidation engine (no broker call); coin collateral; crypto-specific shocks can coincide with the macro date; thin daily books outside BTC/ETH ATM; per-leg fees are large for short-dated options; funding on any perp hedge.
strategies.margin_note: Deribit standard margin for short options is roughly max(0.15 - OTM fraction, 0.1) of the underlying plus mark, in coin (verify against the current Deribit margin docs); portfolio margin available. US persons are restricted from Deribit; US routes are CME BTC/ETH options (options on futures: futures-style, Section 1256) or IBIT options (equity options, not 1256).
strategies.crypto_notes: Core entry. DVOL (30-day BTC implied vol index) 1D candles from public/get_volatility_index_data: one call returns 1000 days and a continuation cursor; paging reaches back to 2021-04. Expiries: settlement_period day/week/month, 08:00 UTC. IBIT options: US hours only, Friday weeklies.
strategies.metals_notes: Same event list as gold; run side by side with metals-macro-event-straddle to see whether BTC event moves co-move with GC.
strategies.claim: On FOMC decision days since April 2021, a 1-day ATM BTC straddle model-priced with DVOL-as-IV (sigma = DVOL at 00:00 UTC of the decision day, T = 1/365) and sold at 00:00 UTC has a lower mean P&L than the same model-priced straddle on non-FOMC days, settled on the next 00:00 UTC BTC close.

trial.statistic: Difference in mean MODEL-PRICED short-straddle P&L (FOMC minus non-FOMC), bootstrap CI; mean |r|/(DVOL/sqrt(365)) by group.
trial.null: FOMC mean P&L >= non-FOMC mean P&L.
trial.procedure: Page DVOL 1D candles back to 2021-04; BTC daily closes aligned to 00:00 UTC (match DVOL candle timestamps); FOMC dates (about 44 events); pooled FOMC+CPI (about 110) as a variant with CPI dates hardcoded from BLS archives.
trial.data: Deribit DVOL history (public API), BTC daily closes, FOMC calendar.
trial.pass: Difference < 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 (FOMC-only; pooled reported alongside).
trial.controls: Random non-macro days; weekend exclusion; VIX-regime control; check BTC- vs USD-accounting give the same sign.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Reuse the BTC VRP harness (DVOL vs realised) with an event-date mask; add a coin-settled payoff mode (payoff/S_T plus coin-premium accounting) to the payoff engine.

strategies.name: Crypto scheduled-catalyst strangle (ETF decisions, halving, protocol upgrades)

legs.expiry_rule: first weekly/monthly expiry AFTER the scheduled date, bought 2-4 weeks before

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: USD: max(S_T-Kc,0) + max(Kp-S_T,0) - D (coin-settled BTC payoff = that intrinsic / S_T, identical in USD at S_T). Usually closed before the decision (sell the ramp) or the day after (hold through).
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited upside in USD; Kp - D on the downside.
strategies.max_loss: D, if Kp <= S_T <= Kc.
strategies.breakevens: Kp - D and Kc + D (USD).

greeks_at_inception.delta: approx 0 option delta (plus long-coin delta from coin-denominated premium/collateral)
greeks_at_inception.vega: positive (the ramp into the catalyst is the main driver)

strategies.when_to_use: Hard-dated catalysts: SEC ETF deadlines, Bitcoin halving (block-height determined), Ethereum upgrades, large token unlocks, distribution dates. Buy when the event-expiry IV premium over DVOL is below comparable past catalysts; sell before the decision (ramp) or hold through (move).
strategies.risks: Deadline slippage leaves you holding decaying premium; 'sell the news' reversals; very few comparable events, so this is a judgement trade with defined risk, not yet validated.
strategies.margin_note: Debit only on Deribit; US-regulated route via IBIT/ETHA options or CME options.
strategies.crypto_notes: Core crypto entry. Coin settlement does not require over-buying puts: the BTC put payoff (K-S_T)/S_T is convex in coin terms and equals K-S_T in USD at S_T. For USD accounting, hedge the coin premium/collateral with a short perp. Weekly expiries Fridays 08:00 UTC; monthlies last Friday.
strategies.metals_notes: Hard-dated gold events are policy and data (see metals entry); no supply-schedule event like a halving.
variants: Call-only ramp when Polymarket approval odds rise
Short strangle after the event (post-event crush)
Calendar: long event expiry / short prior weekly
strategies.claim: For hard-dated BTC/ETH catalysts, a 25-delta strangle in the first expiry after the date, bought 21 days before and sold 1 day before, has a positive mean return on debit net of fees.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit; mean change in event-expiry IV minus change in DVOL over the window; exact sign test given small n.
trial.procedure: Capture event-expiry mark IV and DVOL daily from the Deribit public book (from today); for each catalyst compute window statistics; cross-check with Polymarket odds for the event.
trial.data: Deribit book captures (mark IV by expiry), DVOL, catalyst calendar, Polymarket event odds.
trial.pass: Sign test p < 0.05 and mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 once n >= 20.
trial.controls: Non-catalyst 21-day windows; DVOL-only control; ETF-type vs protocol-type split.

strategies.blocked_on: Deribit expiry-level IV capture across >= 20 hard-dated catalysts (years at current frequency; partial evidence after 3-5).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Catalyst calendar joined to Deribit expiry-level IV captures and Polymarket odds; report IV ramp per event.

strategies.name: Deribit expiry max-pain pin (sell the 08:00 UTC settlement straddle)

legs.strike_rule: max-pain strike (minimises total option payout given OI) if within +/-2% of spot, else ATM
legs.expiry_rule: BTC/ETH monthly or quarterly expiry (last Friday, 08:00 UTC), entered 00:00 UTC same day (8h to expiry)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: USD: Cr - |S_T - K| (coin terms: Cr_btc - |S_T-K|/S_T). S_T = Deribit index averaged over the 30 minutes before 08:00 UTC.
strategies.max_profit: Cr at S_T = K.
strategies.max_loss: Unlimited upside in USD (call leg capped at 1 BTC per contract in coin); downside K - Cr in USD (unbounded in coin terms).
strategies.breakevens: K - Cr and K + Cr.

greeks_at_inception.delta: approx 0 (plus long-coin delta from coin premium)

strategies.when_to_use: Large Deribit monthly/quarterly expiries with concentrated OI; sell 8h before settlement when spot is within 2% of max pain. The averaged settlement damps the final move.
strategies.risks: Pinning is weak in crypto; Asian-session liquidity; a 3% move in 8h costs several credits; liquidation on margin.
strategies.margin_note: Deribit coin margin; US persons use CME BTC options or IBIT monthly opex as the regulated analogue.
strategies.crypto_notes: Core entry. Monthly instruments expire 08:00 UTC on the last Friday (e.g. 2026-10-30, 2026-11-27 in the live instrument list); weeklies Fridays; dailies every day including weekends. public/get_book_summary_by_currency exposes OI per instrument for max pain.
strategies.metals_notes: COMEX OG expiry is the metals analogue; GC round-strike pinning is anecdotal and untested here.
variants: Short daily straddle on every Friday
Long straddle when spot > 3% from max pain
Max-pain convergence test once OI history exists
strategies.claim: An 8-hour ATM BTC short straddle model-priced with DVOL-as-IV (T = 8/(24*365)), sold at 00:00 UTC and settled on the 08:00 UTC price, has a higher mean P&L on Deribit monthly-expiry Fridays than on other Fridays.

trial.statistic: Difference in mean MODEL-PRICED P&L (monthly-expiry Fridays minus other Fridays), bootstrap CI; mean |00-08 UTC return| by group (permutation test).
trial.null: Monthly-expiry mean P&L <= other-Friday mean P&L.
trial.procedure: BTC-PERPETUAL hourly candles from public/get_tradingview_chart_data (available back to 2019; a proxy for the settlement index), DVOL 1D for pricing (from 2021-04); monthly expiry calendar (last Friday). Max-pain convergence (|S_08 - K_maxpain| vs |S_00 - K_maxpain|) needs OI captures.
trial.data: Deribit public hourly perp candles, DVOL history, expiry calendar.
trial.pass: Difference > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Weekly vs monthly split; exclude expiries coinciding with FOMC/CPI; ETH separately.

strategies.harness_suggestion: Deribit hourly candle fetcher + expiry calendar; max-pain calculator from book-summary OI captures (convergence test after ~12 monthly expiries).

strategies.name: Dividend run-up and ex-dividend option plays

legs.strike_rule: K1 ITM about 5% (about 70-delta), stock replacement for the run-up
legs.expiry_rule: expiry AFTER the ex-dividend date (20-45 DTE)

legs.strike_rule: K2 OTM 5% (optional; converts to a call spread)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Spread: min(max(S-K1,0), K2-K1) - D; single call: max(S-K1,0) - D. Normally closed at the last cum-dividend close, capturing the run-up but not the ex-date drop (call holders do not get the dividend; the expected drop is already in the call price).
strategies.max_profit: Spread: (K2-K1) - D at expiry; single call: unlimited. Pre-ex exit: about delta*run-up + theta*dt.
strategies.max_loss: D.
strategies.breakevens: K1 + D at expiry (both versions).
strategies.when_to_use: Between declaration (or the predictable dividend month for regular payers) and the ex-date, for stocks with trailing yield > 3% where a pre-ex drift is claimed. Exit at the last cum-dividend close. Under T+1 settlement the ex-date is normally the record date (investor.gov). Separate variant: dividend-capture exercise of deep-ITM calls on the last cum day when the call's extrinsic (or the matching put value) is below the dividend.
strategies.risks: The run-up anomaly is small (tens of bps) and cost-sensitive; option spreads may exceed the edge; a short call through the ex-date risks early assignment (you lose the dividend); dividend cuts.
strategies.margin_note: Debit. The exercise variant needs buying power to take delivery of 100 shares per contract for one night.
strategies.crypto_notes: No dividends. Analogue is staking-reward or airdrop snapshot dates (spot run-up into the snapshot, drop after); Deribit ETH option forwards do not embed staking yield directly.
strategies.metals_notes: No dividends on GLD/SLV/GC; not applicable (GC contango roll is carry, not an event).
variants: 70-delta call vs call spread vs synthetic long (long ATM call + short ATM put)
Dividend-capture exercise of deep-ITM calls on the last cum day
Short put through the ex-date (puts carry the expected drop)
Ex-date short straddle as a placebo
strategies.claim: For US stocks with trailing dividend yield > 3%, a 70-delta call in the first expiry after the ex-date, bought at the close 10 trading days before the ex-date and sold at the last cum-dividend close, has a positive mean return on debit net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit with bootstrap CI; underlying excess return (event window minus matched non-event window) as the mechanism check.
trial.procedure: Build the ex-date calendar; for each (stock, ex-date) mark the 70-delta call from chain captures at entry and exit; compute the underlying 10-day pre-ex return and a matched control.
trial.data: Ex-dividend dates (Nasdaq dividend calendar / EDGAR, free, not wired), single-name daily closes, chain captures.
trial.pass: Mean call return > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Same stocks on random dates; SPY-adjusted returns; yield-tercile monotonicity.

strategies.blocked_on: ex-dividend date history and single-name closes (free, not wired); chain capture for call marks (~1 quarter for 500 ex-dates across a broad universe).

strategies.name: Earnings iron condor / iron butterfly (defined-risk IV crush)
strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Cr + max(K1-S,0) - max(K2-S,0) - max(S-K3,0) + max(S-K4,0). Iron butterfly: K2=K3=ATM.
strategies.max_profit: Cr, if K2 <= S_T <= K3.
strategies.max_loss: (K2-K1) - Cr for S_T <= K1; (K4-K3) - Cr for S_T >= K4; overall max(K2-K1, K4-K3) - Cr.
strategies.breakevens: K2 - Cr and K3 + Cr.
strategies.when_to_use: Same filter as the naked strangle (IM/HM > 1.2) when the account cannot carry naked risk or the name has a history of >2x gaps; wings at 2x implied move cap the tail. Iron butterfly when IM is extremely rich and maximum credit is wanted.
strategies.risks: Defined loss, but a 2x gap goes straight to max loss; four legs of bid/ask in illiquid names can eat half the credit; pin risk at K2/K3 if held to Friday; early exercise of a short ITM call around an ex-date.
strategies.margin_note: Reg-T margin = max wing width - credit; IRA-eligible at most brokers.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit iron condors on BTC/ETH weeklies: USD strikes, premiums and settlement in coin. Per-leg taker fees (a small % of underlying notional, capped at a fraction of the option price; check the current Deribit fee schedule) matter more than on US equity options with 4 legs. Portfolio margin recognises the spread.
strategies.metals_notes: GC options iron condor around FOMC/NFP using short-dated GC weeklies; SPAN recognises the spread; GLD iron condor is the equity-option route.
variants: Broken-wing condor (wider call wing for negative-skew names)
Hold to expiry vs cover at post-print open
strategies.claim: An iron condor with shorts at 1x implied move and longs at 2x implied move, sold at the T-1 close and covered at the T+1 open, has a positive mean return on max loss net of four half-spreads across US large-cap earnings.

trial.statistic: Mean return on max loss with bootstrap CI; secondary: paired difference in mean/CVaR(5%) vs the naked 1x-IM strangle on the same prints.
trial.procedure: Same pipeline as the short strangle, adding the long wings at 2x IM; per-print paired comparison; walk-forward IM/HM filter.
trial.data: Daily chain captures + daily OHLC; earnings dates.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 out-of-sample.
trial.controls: Placebo nights; spread-cost sensitivity (0.5x, 1x, 1.5x quoted half-spread); sector stratification.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Payoff engine already handles 4-leg structures; add a 'paired structures on same event' comparator to the trial runner.

strategies.name: Earnings IV-crush short straddle/strangle

legs.strike_rule: Kc OTM at 1.0-1.5x implied move (about 16-25 delta); straddle variant ATM
legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after earnings (1-3 DTE at entry)

legs.strike_rule: Kp OTM at 1.0-1.5x implied move (about 16-25 delta); straddle variant ATM

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Cr - max(S-Kc,0) - max(Kp-S,0). Covered at the post-print open: P&L = Cr - post-crush strangle value - costs.
strategies.max_profit: Cr (net credit), if Kp <= S_T <= Kc.
strategies.max_loss: Unlimited on the upside; Kp - Cr on the downside (S->0).
strategies.breakevens: Kp - Cr and Kc + Cr.
strategies.when_to_use: Sell at the close before the print when the implied move exceeds the stock's trailing realised earnings move by a margin (IM/HM > 1.2), event-expiry IV rank > 70, and the name has no history of >2x-implied gaps. Cover at the post-print open; do not hold to expiry.
strategies.risks: Fat-tail gaps (3-5x implied happen several times a season in a 200-name universe); many small wins and rare large losses, so Sharpe looks good until it does not; margin calls at the open; early assignment on an ITM short call before an ex-date; brokers raise margin into earnings.
strategies.margin_note: Reg-T naked equity option margin per side: premium + max(20%*S - OTM amount, 10% of S for calls / 10% of K for puts); for a strangle, the larger side's requirement plus the other side's premium. Portfolio margin stresses single names roughly +/-15%. Many brokers forbid naked short calls in IRAs; use the iron condor there.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit equivalent: sell BTC/ETH strangles into scheduled catalysts. In USD the short put loses K-S_T (linear); in BTC it loses (K-S_T)/S_T, which accelerates as BTC falls, while coin collateral also loses USD value, so the liquidation engine (acts 24/7) bites hardest in a crash. Portfolio margin on Deribit nets risk across the book.
strategies.metals_notes: Analogue: sell GC weekly strangles before NFP/CPI (see metals entry). Futures options: SPAN margin, Section 1256 60/40.
variants: Jade lizard (short put + short call spread) when skew is steep
Sell at T-1 close, hold to Friday expiry (adds post-print theta and drift risk)
strategies.claim: Selling a 1x-implied-move strangle in the first post-earnings expiry at the T-1 close and covering at the T+1 open has a positive mean P&L on Reg-T margin, net of half-spreads, across US large-cap earnings.

trial.statistic: Mean P&L as % of margin with bootstrap CI; hit rate, 5% CVaR and mean/CVaR reported for sizing.
trial.procedure: From the implied-move dataset: strangle credit at the T-1 close, value at the T+1 open (reprice with T+1 captured IV and the gap); subtract spread costs; aggregate by season; walk-forward IM/HM filter.
trial.data: Daily chain captures + daily OHLC; earnings dates.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 on out-of-sample seasons; mean/CVaR(5%) >= 0.1 required before sizing above 1% of capital.
trial.controls: Random-night placebo; IM/HM terciles to check monotonicity; drop the 5 largest losses and confirm the sign is unchanged (robustness, not proof).

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Short-vol event harness reporting CVaR and Kelly fraction with the mean; Reg-T margin formula in the payoff engine so P&L is reported on margin.

strategies.name: Earnings overwrite (covered call sold into the print)

legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after earnings, sold at the T-1 close

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Per share: S_T - S0 + C - max(S_T-K,0). Usually the call is bought back at the T+1 open after the crush.
strategies.max_profit: K - S0 + C.
strategies.breakevens: S0 - C.
strategies.when_to_use: For holders who would keep the stock through the print anyway: sell event-expiry calls at about 1x implied move when IM/HM > 1.0, buy back after the crush.
strategies.risks: Upside gaps above K are given away; assignment if ITM before an ex-date; the stock's downside is unhedged.
strategies.margin_note: Covered: no margin beyond the stock. Not Section 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: Analogue: covered calls on spot BTC/ETH via Deribit into a catalyst; coin-settled call loss is capped at 1 BTC per contract, matching the coin held.
strategies.metals_notes: Not earnings-driven; GLD overwrite into FOMC is the analogue.
variants: Hold to expiry vs cover at T+1 open
strategies.claim: For US large-cap holders, selling a 1x-implied-move call in the first post-earnings expiry at the T-1 close and covering at the T+1 open raises the mean T-1-to-T+1-open return of the stock position, net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean of (overwrite P&L - stock-only P&L) per event, bootstrap CI.
trial.procedure: Chain captures at T-1 close and T+1 (reprice with captured IV and gap); per-event paired difference.
trial.data: Chain captures, daily OHLC, earnings dates.
trial.pass: Mean difference > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 out-of-sample.
trial.controls: IM/HM terciles; placebo nights; drop the 5 largest upside gaps.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.

strategies.name: Earnings protective collar (hedge a long through the print)

legs.strike_rule: Kc chosen so call premium about equals put premium (zero-cost)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Per share: min(max(S_T,Kp),Kc) - S0 - D, D = P - C (about 0 for zero-cost).
strategies.max_profit: Kc - S0 - D.
strategies.max_loss: S0 - Kp + D.
strategies.breakevens: S0 + D.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: about 0 (long put gamma vs short call gamma)
greeks_at_inception.vega: about 0 net; long put-wing vol / short call-wing vol

strategies.when_to_use: Holders who cannot sell (tax, lockup, conviction) and want a defined range through the print; best when call IV is rich enough to finance the put without giving away much upside.
strategies.risks: Upside capped at Kc; steep put skew makes the zero-cost call strike close to spot; assignment on the short call before an ex-date.
strategies.margin_note: Stock covers the call; put is a debit. Not Section 1256; collars can affect holding period for tax (straddle rules).
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit collar on spot BTC/ETH holdings into catalysts; coin-settled legs, USD strikes.
strategies.metals_notes: GLD collar into FOMC/CPI; GC collar via futures options for futures holders.
variants: Put spread collar (cheaper, gap risk below the lower put)
strategies.claim: Across US large-cap earnings, the mean T-1-close-to-T+1-open return of a zero-cost 25-delta-put collared long is not lower than the unhedged long's mean return by more than half the collar's round-trip spread cost.

trial.statistic: Mean of (collar P&L - stock-only P&L) per event, bootstrap CI.
trial.null: Mean difference < -(half round-trip spread cost), i.e. the hedge has a real cost beyond frictions.
trial.procedure: Chain captures at T-1 close and T+1; paired per-event difference; report variance reduction.
trial.data: Chain captures, daily OHLC, earnings dates.
trial.pass: 95% CI lower bound of the difference >= -(half round-trip spread cost).
trial.controls: Skew deciles; sector strata; placebo nights.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Same paired comparator as the overwrite; report variance and CVaR reduction.

strategies.name: Earnings reverse calendar / event forward-variance sale (sell event expiry, buy next)

legs.expiry_rule: NEAR: first expiry AFTER earnings (1-5 DTE)

legs.strike_rule: ATM; qty r = sqrt(T_near/T_far) per near unit so far vega = near vega (typically 0.3-0.5)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: At near expiry: Cr_near - |S-K| + r*(F(S) - D_far), where F(S) = far straddle value at S with post-crush IV and D_far = far straddle cost per unit. Profits if the realised event move is smaller than the event variance implied by the two expiries.
strategies.max_profit: At S_T=K: Cr_near + r*(F(K) - D_far) (finite).
strategies.max_loss: Unbounded: for a move of size m, loss grows about (1-r)*m - Cr_near - r*(F(K+m) - m - D_far); the far legs only offset fraction r of the near intrinsic.
strategies.breakevens: Numerical; roughly K +/- (Cr_near + r*(F(K) - D_far))/(1-r).

greeks_at_inception.gamma: negative (near gamma dominates even after the ratio)
greeks_at_inception.vega: approx 0 by construction (vega-neutral), but short event variance and long ambient vol

strategies.when_to_use: When the event variance E = sigma_near^2*T_near - sigma_fwd^2*T_near, with sigma_fwd^2 = (sigma_far^2*T_far - sigma_near^2*T_near)/(T_far - T_near), is high relative to trailing realised event moves, and you want to sell the event without ambient-vol risk.
strategies.risks: Not hedged against a big gap (net short gamma); the far leg also crushes after the print (whole surface drops), so vega-neutral at inception is not vega-neutral at T+1; four legs of slippage.
strategies.margin_note: Only r of each near leg is covered by a later-expiry long at the same strike; the remaining (1-r) short straddles are margined as naked. The 1:1 version is a covered short time spread for margin.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit term structure around FOMC/ETF dates: sell the expiry containing the event, buy the next monthly; DVOL is a 30-day blend and cannot isolate event vol, so use the two expiries' mark IVs from the public book.
strategies.metals_notes: GC: sell the weekly spanning FOMC/NFP, buy the serial monthly; SPAN nets the time spread.
variants: Double reverse calendar at +/-1 IM strikes
Event variance swap replication via strike strips
strategies.claim: Selling the ATM straddle in the first post-earnings expiry and buying a vega-matched ATM straddle in the following monthly, entered at the T-1 close and closed at the T+1 open, has a positive mean P&L net of half-spreads across US large-cap earnings.

trial.statistic: Mean P&L with bootstrap CI; secondary: paired Sharpe difference vs the naked short straddle on the same prints.
trial.procedure: Chain-capture marks at the T-1 close and T+1 (reprice the far leg with captured T+1 IV); per-print P&L for both structures; paired bootstrap.
trial.data: Daily chain captures incl. monthly expiries; earnings dates.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 out-of-sample.
trial.controls: Placebo nights; vega-ratio sensitivity (0.3, 0.4, 0.5); exclude prints within 5 days of index opex.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Forward-variance calculator in the engine: sigma_fwd^2 = (s2^2*T2 - s1^2*T1)/(T2-T1); event variance E = s1^2*T1 - sigma_fwd^2*T1.

strategies.name: Earnings risk reversal on extreme skew (long put / short call into the print)

legs.strike_rule: Kc OTM 25-delta (Kp < S < Kc); hypothesis-A variant reverses both sides

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: max(Kp-S_T,0) - max(S_T-Kc,0) - D, where D = put premium - call premium (usually a net debit when put skew is steep; negative D is a credit). Short-stock-like outside the strikes, flat between.
strategies.max_loss: Unlimited (upside, short call).
strategies.breakevens: Net debit: Kp - D. Net credit (D<0): Kc + |D|. Zero cost: flat between Kp and Kc.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: about 0 at spot (long put gamma offsets short call gamma)
greeks_at_inception.theta: slightly negative when paying the rich put
greeks_at_inception.vega: about 0 net; long put-wing vol / short call-wing vol, so long skew (gains if put IV rises relative to call IV)

strategies.when_to_use: When the pre-earnings 25-delta put IV minus 25-delta call IV in the event expiry is in the top decile of the stock's own history; Xing-Zhang-Zhao find a steep implied-vol smirk predicts lower future stock returns and worse earnings surprises. Hypothesis A (steep skew mean-reverts: long call / short put) is the variant the trial must also reject or confirm.
strategies.risks: Directional with unlimited upside loss on a beat; early assignment on a short ITM call before an ex-date; the smirk evidence is mostly at weekly/monthly horizons and may not hold at the event horizon.
strategies.margin_note: Short call is naked (Reg-T premium + max(20%*S - OTM, 10%*S)) unless covered by stock; long put is a debit. Not Section 1256 for single stocks.
strategies.crypto_notes: BTC/ETH 25-delta skew on Deribit swings around catalysts; same structure. Short call in coin terms loses at most 1 BTC per contract, but in USD the loss is unlimited.
strategies.metals_notes: GLD/GC skew is often call-side rich; the mirror (long call / short put when put skew is extreme) is the metals analogue into FOMC.
variants: Hypothesis A: long call / short put (skew mean-reversion)
Put spread vs short call spread (capped both sides)
Hold through vs close at the T+1 open
strategies.claim: For US stocks whose pre-earnings 25-delta put-minus-call IV skew in the event expiry is in the top decile of its own history, a 25-delta long put / short call risk reversal opened at the T-1 close and closed at the T+1 open has a positive mean P&L per unit of spot net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean P&L per unit spot with bootstrap CI; Spearman between skew decile and T+1 open return as mechanism check.
trial.procedure: From chain captures interpolate 25-delta IVs at the T-1 close; sort into deciles; reprice at T+1 captured IV and opening gap; walk-forward decile cutoffs.
trial.data: Daily chain captures (IV by delta), earnings dates, daily OHLC.
trial.pass: Top-decile mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 out-of-sample (at least 30 top-decile events).
trial.controls: Placebo nights; control for prior-month return; sector dummies; hypothesis-A structure as the opposite-sign check.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Skew-by-delta extractor (interpolate IV at 25-delta) stored per symbol-day; shared with the skew-family harness.

strategies.name: Earnings-season dispersion (long single-name straddles, short index straddle)

legs.strike_rule: index ATM (SPX/SPY or sector ETF such as XLK)
legs.expiry_rule: expiry after the peak of earnings season (30-45 DTE at entry, entered about 5 trading days after quarter-end)

legs.strike_rule: ATM on each top constituent, dollar-weight w_i = index weight x index notional / S_i
ATM on each constituent, same weights

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Sum_i w_i|S_i,T - K_i| - |I_T - K_I| - D, with D = sum_i w_i*straddle_i - straddle_I (net debit). With dollar weights and K_I = sum_i w_i*K_i, the triangle inequality gives sum_i w_i|S_i - K_i| >= |I - K_I| for the replicated basket.
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited (large offsetting single-name moves with a flat index).
strategies.max_loss: D (all names move together so the triangle inequality is tight), plus tracking error between the basket and the index.
strategies.breakevens: Sum_i w_i|S_i,T - K_i| - |I_T - K_I| = D.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: long single-name gamma, short index gamma (net long dispersion / short realised correlation)
greeks_at_inception.vega: long single-name vega, short index vega (short implied correlation)

strategies.when_to_use: Earnings season, when single-name event variance is high and idiosyncratic, so realised correlation tends to fall; enter when implied correlation (index IV^2 relative to weighted single-name IV^2) is high versus its history.
strategies.risks: Macro shock during the season raises correlation (all names move together); many legs and spreads; constituent basket tracking error; single-name early assignment is irrelevant for long legs, but index short is cash-settled.
strategies.margin_note: Short index straddle margined as naked unless offset under portfolio margin; long single-name legs are debits. SPX short leg Section 1256, single names not.
strategies.crypto_notes: Weak analogue: long ETH/alt vol vs short BTC vol around network-specific events; Deribit lists few alts.
strategies.metals_notes: Analogue: long GDX miners' vol vs short GLD vol around miners' earnings; not tested here.
variants: Sector version (XLK vs its top names)
strategies.claim: A dollar-weighted long-dispersion book (long ATM straddles on the top 20 SPX constituents, short the ATM SPX straddle) opened 5 trading days after quarter-end and closed 25 trading days later has a positive mean P&L on debit net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean P&L on debit per season with bootstrap CI over seasons and a per-name decomposition; implied minus realised correlation as mechanism.
trial.procedure: Chain captures at entry/exit; realised correlation from single-name closes; one book per season (plus overlapping weekly-start variants for power).
trial.data: Chain captures (SPX + top 20 names), single-name closes; Cboe implied-correlation index history (free, not wired) for a longer proxy.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 over >= 8 seasons (or >= 40 overlapping weekly starts with block bootstrap).
trial.controls: Same book in non-earnings windows; VIX-change control; sector strata.

strategies.blocked_on: chain capture across >= 8 earnings seasons (about 2 years) or a longer proxy from Cboe implied-correlation history plus single-name closes (both not wired).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Basket-straddle builder from the chain store; implied vs realised correlation calculator.

strategies.name: Election / political-event straddle (index vol spanning a scheduled vote)

legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after election day, bought 5 trading days before

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: |S_T - K| - D; usually closed the day after the result.
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited upside; K - D downside.
strategies.max_loss: D.
strategies.breakevens: K - D and K + D.

greeks_at_inception.vega: positive (event-expiry IV carries a political-uncertainty premium)

strategies.when_to_use: US federal elections, referendums, debt-ceiling deadlines with a known date. Kelly-Pastor-Veronesi show options spanning elections are more expensive; buy only when the event-expiry premium is low relative to the outcome dispersion implied by Polymarket/Kalshi odds (close race, divergent policy outcomes).
strategies.risks: Political-uncertainty premium is priced, so the default is negative expectancy; delayed results; tiny sample.
strategies.margin_note: Debit; SPX/XSP Section 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: BTC moved strongly around the 2024 US election; Deribit weekly straddle across the date; Polymarket election odds as the dispersion signal.
strategies.metals_notes: GLD straddle across the election; gold reacts to fiscal/tariff implications.
variants: Calendar: long post-election expiry / short pre-election expiry
Short straddle when the premium is extreme
VIX call spread into the election
strategies.claim: On US federal election days since 1994, SPY's absolute 2-day return (close before election day to close after) divided by the VIX-implied 2-day move (VIX/sqrt(126)) is larger than the same ratio on matched non-election 2-day windows.

trial.statistic: Mean ratio difference (election minus matched windows); exact sign test across 16 elections; MODEL-PRICED straddle P&L with VIX-as-IV.
trial.procedure: Elections 1994-2024 (16 dates, every 2 years); SPY closes, VIX; matched windows = same weekday pairs 4 weeks before/after.
trial.data: SPY daily closes, VIX, election dates; Polymarket/Kalshi odds for 2024+ only.
trial.pass: Sign test p < 0.05 (>= 13 of 16) and mean difference > 0 (underpowered: report as indicative).
trial.controls: Presidential vs midterm split; VIX regime; exclude 2008 (crisis).

strategies.harness_suggestion: Reuse the VIX-as-IV event pricer with a 2-day horizon; add Polymarket odds as a covariate when n grows.

strategies.name: Hold-through-earnings long straddle/strangle (realised move > implied move)

legs.strike_rule: ATM (straddle) or Kc = S*(1+IM) (strangle, OTM by 1x implied move)
legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after earnings, 1-7 DTE at entry

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Straddle: |S-K|-D. Strangle (Kp<Kc): max(S-Kc,0)+max(Kp-S,0)-D. Closed the morning after the print, so P&L = gap P&L on remaining value minus IV crush on remaining extrinsic.
strategies.max_profit: Unlimited as S->inf; K-D (straddle) or Kp-D (strangle) as S->0.
strategies.max_loss: D, at S_T=K (straddle) or Kp<=S_T<=Kc (strangle). Post-print exit with |move| < implied move typically loses a large fraction of D because of IV crush.
strategies.breakevens: Straddle: K-D and K+D. Strangle: Kp-D and Kc+D. Implied move: the ATM straddle price equals the risk-neutral E|S_T-K|, so mean-abs IM = straddle/S; the one-sigma move is about straddle/(0.8*S); the median-abs move (comparable to a median of past gaps) is about 0.845*straddle/S (0.674/0.798 under normality).

greeks_at_inception.theta: strongly negative (overnight decay plus the IV crush is paid at the print)
greeks_at_inception.vega: positive, but event IV collapses after the print

strategies.when_to_use: Only when the implied move is below the stock's historical realised earnings move by a margin: IM/HM < 0.8 with IM = 0.845*straddle/S and HM = median |gap| of the last 8-12 prints; or when a specific catalyst (guidance change, activist, restructuring) fattens the distribution. Buy at the close before the print, sell at the open or first 30 minutes after.
strategies.risks: Base rate: implied moves overstate realised moves most of the time (earnings variance premium), so the unfiltered trade is negative-expectancy; weekend/holiday prints; pre-market gap that unwinds; wide opening spreads; halts.
strategies.margin_note: Debit only. Single-stock options are not Section 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: Analogue: hold a Deribit straddle through a binary catalyst (court ruling, ETF deadline). Coin settlement converts back to the vanilla USD payoff at S_T, so no extra put notional is needed for a USD-targeted strangle; hedge the coin premium/collateral delta with a perp instead.
strategies.metals_notes: Analogue is holding GC/GLD straddles through 8:30 ET releases (NFP/CPI); see metals-macro-event-straddle.
variants: Ratio strangle (2 puts : 1 call) for negative-skew names
Buy the week before and hold through (ramp + move)
Long event straddle + short next-month straddle to hedge the crush (inverse of earnings-reverse-calendar)
strategies.claim: Among US large-cap earnings events with IM/HM < 0.8 (IM = 0.845*ATM straddle/S at the T-1 close, HM = median |gap| over the prior 8 prints), an ATM straddle bought at the T-1 close and sold at the T+1 open has a positive mean return on debit net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean per-trade return on debit in the filtered bucket with bootstrap CI; unfiltered mean and hit rate reported as the base-rate control.
trial.procedure: Record straddle mid at the T-1 close and at the T+1 open (or reprice with the T+1 captured IV and the opening gap when no intraday snapshot exists); compute IM and HM; bucket by IM/HM; threshold chosen on the first season, tested walk-forward.
trial.data: Daily chain capture + daily OHLC for ~200 names (single-name OHLC free, not wired); earnings dates from EDGAR.
trial.pass: Filtered-bucket mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0 out-of-sample, with at least 60 filtered events.
trial.controls: Placebo: same filter on random non-earnings nights; shuffled IM/HM labels; drop the top-3 winners and re-test; unfiltered mean expected < 0.

strategies.blocked_on: daily chain capture through 2+ earnings seasons; earnings-date history; T+1 marks (needs the T+1 chain capture for the IV crush).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Implied-move vs realised-move table per symbol-quarter as a first-class dataset; it feeds this and the short-vol earnings entries.

strategies.name: Implied-move vs realised-move signal (conditional straddle, side chosen by IM/HM)

legs.strike_rule: ATM; side flips to LONG when IM/HM < 0.8 (short when IM/HM > 1.2, no trade in between)
legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after the event (earnings, FOMC, CPI)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Short: Cr - |S-K|. Long: |S-K| - D. Marked at the post-event open/close.
strategies.max_profit: Short: Cr. Long: unlimited upside; K-D as S->0.
strategies.max_loss: Short: unlimited upside; K-Cr as S->0. Long: D.
strategies.breakevens: K - premium and K + premium.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: positive if long, negative if short
greeks_at_inception.theta: negative if long, positive if short
greeks_at_inception.vega: positive if long, negative if short

strategies.when_to_use: Any scheduled event with a priced straddle: IM = 0.845*straddle_mid/S when compared with HM = median |event return| over the last 8-12 same-type events (use straddle/S if HM is a mean). Trade only in the tails of IM/HM. This is the gating signal for the earnings-vol and macro-event entries.
strategies.risks: Regime shifts make historical moves irrelevant; an 8-point median is noisy; the ratio tails are populated by illiquid names with fictional mids. In the VIX-proxy version IM comes from a 30-day index, not an event-expiry price, so the signal is a proxy.
strategies.margin_note: As per the chosen side (naked margin when short; debit when long).
strategies.crypto_notes: For BTC/ETH use a DVOL-implied move: IM = DVOL/sqrt(365)*sqrt(hours/24) (Deribit suggests DVOL/20 as a rough daily move); realised from BTC closes. DVOL 1D history is paginated via the continuation field back to 2021-04 (about 44 FOMC meetings), not only the ~1000 days of one call.
strategies.metals_notes: GLD/GC: IM from the GLD ATM straddle or GVZ; HM from GLD daily returns on past NFP/CPI/FOMC days.
variants: SPX FOMC days with VIX-as-IV (model-priced, testable now)
strategies.claim: Across scheduled FOMC days since 1994, the ratio IM/HM (IM = 0.845*VIX-as-IV one-day straddle/S, HM = median |SPY return| over the prior 8 FOMC days) is negatively rank-correlated with the subsequent model-priced long-straddle P&L.

trial.statistic: Spearman rho between IM/HM and the model-priced long-straddle return; Q5-Q1 quintile mean difference with bootstrap CI.
trial.procedure: For each FOMC event: straddle priced by Black-Scholes with sigma = VIX_{T-1}, T=1/252 on SPY_{T-1} (MODEL-PRICED, not traded prices); realised P&L = |SPY_T - SPY_{T-1}| - straddle; HM from prior 8 FOMC-day moves. Walk-forward: cutoffs on 1994-2009, test 2010-2026. Traded-price version for earnings later from chains.
trial.data: Now: SPY daily closes since 1993, VIX daily since 1990, FOMC dates (Fed calendars). Later: chain captures + earnings dates.
trial.pass: rho < -0.1 with p < 0.05 out-of-sample and Q1-Q5 > 0 with CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Placebo on random non-event days; partial out VIX level; close-to-close vs close-to-open realised definitions (open requires OHLC, not in the current data list).

strategies.harness_suggestion: Event-move table (event_type, date, IM, HM, realised) as the shared dataset for the family; build the VIX-as-IV SPY FOMC version first and flag it MODEL-PRICED.

strategies.name: Index inclusion / rebalance options (S&P 500 adds, Russell reconstitution)

legs.expiry_rule: first expiry AFTER the effective (inclusion) date

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: min(max(S-K1,0), K2-K1) - D; normally closed at the effective-date close and optionally reversed into a bear put spread for the post-inclusion reversal.
strategies.max_loss: D.
strategies.breakevens: K1 + D.
strategies.when_to_use: After an S&P 500 inclusion announcement (typically 3-7 trading days before effective), buy the call spread at the first open; close at the effective-date close when index funds buy. Reverse variant: after the effective date, bear put spread for the documented partial reversal. Russell variant: reconstitution close in late June.
strategies.risks: The inclusion premium has shrunk with pre-positioning; announcements are after hours so the gap is already in the open; IV jumps at the open; Russell effects are mostly in the closing auction.
strategies.margin_note: Debit spread. Reversal leg: bear put debit spread or bear call credit spread (margin = width - credit).
strategies.crypto_notes: Analogue: exchange listing or index/ETF-basket additions; Deribit lists options mainly on BTC/ETH, so it applies only via BTC/ETH flow events.
strategies.metals_notes: Analogue: BCOM/GSCI annual reweights (January roll window) moving GC/SI; GC call/put spreads across the window. Section 1256.
variants: Russell reconstitution IWM straddle into the reconstitution close
Pair: long added-name call spread / short deleted-name call spread
strategies.claim: For S&P 500 additions announced since 2020, a 1-month ATM/+8% call spread bought at the first post-announcement open and sold at the effective-date close has a positive mean return on debit net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit; underlying excess return vs SPY over the same window; bootstrap CIs.
trial.procedure: Collect S&P DJI index-change announcements (announcement and effective dates); mark the spread from chain captures (or BS with captured IV); post-effective 20-day window as the reversal variant.
trial.data: S&P DJI press release history (needs scraping; spglobal.com blocks plain fetches), single-name OHLC, chain captures.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Matched non-included stocks of similar size and momentum; placebo dates; separate bucket for direct adds after IPO/spin-off.

strategies.blocked_on: index-change announcement history (scrape), single-name OHLC; chain capture for option marks (about 60 additions take 1-2 years at current turnover).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Generic 'two-window event' harness (announce->effective, effective->+20d).

strategies.name: IPO lockup-expiry bear put spread

legs.expiry_rule: first expiry after the lockup expiry date, bought 5-10 trading days before

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: max(K2-S,0) - max(K1-S,0) - D.
strategies.max_loss: D.
strategies.breakevens: K2 - D.
strategies.when_to_use: Recent IPOs (especially VC-backed) with listed options approaching the end of the lockup (typically 180 days), where insiders hold a large share of float. Field-Hanka document abnormal negative returns around lockup expiry.
strategies.risks: Well-known and often pre-positioned; recent IPOs are hard to borrow, so puts carry a borrow premium; early releases or staggered lockups change the date; strong momentum names can rally through.
strategies.margin_note: Debit spread; margin = debit.
strategies.crypto_notes: Analogue: large token unlocks (vesting cliffs) on scheduled dates; options exist only on BTC/ETH on Deribit, so use perps or Polymarket-style contracts for alts.
strategies.metals_notes: No analogue.
variants: Short stock + long call (if borrow is available)
strategies.claim: For US IPOs with listed options, an ATM/-12% put spread in the first expiry after lockup expiry, bought 5 trading days before and sold 2 trading days after, has a positive mean return on debit net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean return on debit with bootstrap CI; underlying abnormal return (vs IPO-sector ETF) as mechanism check.
trial.procedure: Lockup dates from IPO prospectuses (EDGAR 424B4, free, not wired); chain captures at entry/exit.
trial.data: EDGAR prospectuses, single-name closes, chain captures.
trial.pass: Mean > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: VC-backed vs not; insider-share-of-float terciles; placebo windows 30 days earlier.

strategies.blocked_on: lockup-date history (EDGAR, not wired) and chain capture across ~80 lockup expiries (about 1-2 years).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Corporate-event calendar table (lockups, spin-offs, index changes) feeding the two-window event harness.

strategies.name: Merger-arbitrage collar on the target (cash deals)

legs.strike_rule: target shares bought at S0 (below the cash deal price P_deal)
legs.expiry_rule: held until deal close or option expiry
first expiry after the expected close date

legs.strike_rule: Kp near the estimated fallback price (pre-announcement price), optional

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Per share: min(max(S_T,Kp),Kc) - S0 + C - P (C = call premium, P = put premium). Without the put: min(S_T,Kc) - S0 + C.
strategies.max_profit: Kc - S0 + C - P per share (deal closes, S_T >= Kc).
strategies.max_loss: S0 - Kp - C + P per share (deal breaks, S_T <= Kp); without the put S0 - C.
strategies.breakevens: S_T = S0 - C + P.

greeks_at_inception.delta: positive but small (1 - delta_call + delta_put, about +0.1 to +0.3 since the call is near ATM-to-ITM)
greeks_at_inception.vega: negative (short call); the long put gains from break-risk vol

strategies.when_to_use: Announced all-cash deals with listed options where the spread (P_deal - S0) annualised exceeds T-bills by a margin and regulatory/financing risk is assessable. The short call monetises the upside the deal caps anyway; the put buys break protection that pure stock merger arb lacks.
strategies.risks: Deal break (target falls toward fallback); timing slippage beyond expiry; bump (competing bid) capped by the short call; early assignment of the short call near close; puts on targets can be expensive.
strategies.margin_note: Covered call plus long put: margin = stock purchase (50% Reg-T) less call premium; no extra requirement for the call. Not Section 1256.
strategies.crypto_notes: No M&A analogue on Deribit; token mergers/migrations are thin and unlisted in options.
strategies.metals_notes: Applies to miners (e.g. gold miner takeovers) via equity options; not to GLD/GC.
variants: Short put at Kp below S0 (synthetic)
Stock-for-stock deals: long target / short acquirer with options
Deal-break put spread only (speculate on break)
strategies.claim: For US all-cash deals with listed options, a target collar (long stock, short call at the highest strike <= deal price, long put near the pre-announcement price) opened at the T+1 close after announcement and held to deal close or expiry has a mean annualised return above the 3-month T-bill rate net of half-spreads.

trial.statistic: Mean annualised excess return over the FRED 3-month bill with bootstrap CI; break-rate and loss-given-break.
trial.procedure: Deal list from EDGAR (DEFM14A / SC TO-T, free, not wired); chain captures at entry; outcome from closes; excess over T-bill.
trial.data: EDGAR deal filings, single-name closes, chain captures, FRED 3-month bill.
trial.pass: Mean excess > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Stock-only merger arb on the same deals (paired); deal-size and regulatory-risk strata; market return over the holding period.

strategies.blocked_on: deal list (EDGAR, not wired) and chain capture through deal completion (months per deal; ~60 deals ~ 1 year).
strategies.harness_suggestion: Deal-tracker table (announce, terms, expected close, outcome) joined to chain captures; payoff engine already supports stock + options legs.

strategies.name: Metals macro-event straddle (FOMC / CPI / NFP) on GC or GLD

legs.strike_rule: ATM (GLD $1 strikes; GC $5/$10 strikes); flip to SHORT when the GLD-straddle or GVZ-implied event move > 1.2x trailing realised event move
legs.expiry_rule: GLD: first weekly expiring after the release (0-2 DTE); GC: nearest short-dated weekly (options on the GC future)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Long: |S_T - K| - D. Short: Cr - |S_T - K|. GLD options are American, physically settled in shares; GC options exercise into GC futures.
strategies.max_profit: Long: unlimited upside; K-D downside. Short: Cr.
strategies.max_loss: Long: D. Short: unlimited upside; K-Cr downside.
strategies.breakevens: K - premium and K + premium. Gold's typical NFP/CPI-day move is about 0.8-1.5%.
strategies.when_to_use: 8:30 ET releases hit gold pre-market: GC trades nearly 23h so the move is tradable live in GC options; GLD options open at 9:30 after the gap, so long GLD straddles must be bought the prior close and short GLD straddles sold at about 9:35 (post-gap crush). FOMC 14:00 ET is live for both. Gate with the implied-vs-realised event-move ratio using GVZ or the GLD straddle.
strategies.risks: GC options exercise into futures (margin jump); gold's reaction to CPI/NFP flips with the real-rate narrative; SLV/SI moves are larger with worse liquidity.
strategies.margin_note: GC options: SPAN futures-style margin, Section 1256 (60/40), CME Globex nearly 23h. GLD/SLV options: equity-option margin, not Section 1256 (GLD shares are taxed as collectibles; confirm with a tax adviser).
strategies.crypto_notes: Run the same event list on BTC (crypto-macro-event-straddle) and test whether gold and BTC event moves co-move.
strategies.metals_notes: Core entry. CME lists short-dated gold weeklies on several weekdays (check current listings; cmegroup.com blocks plain fetches); OG monthly stops trading on the 4th-last business day of the month before the contract month. GVZ (Cboe gold ETF vol index, from GLD options) daily history is a free Cboe CSV starting 2009-09-18.
variants: Long GLD straddle prior close through the 8:30 release
Short GLD straddle at 9:35 after the gap
GC weekly straddle sold 14:05 ET after FOMC
strategies.claim: On FOMC and CPI days since 2009-09, a 1-day ATM GLD straddle model-priced with GVZ-as-IV (sigma = GVZ at the T-1 close, T = 1/252) and sold at the T-1 close has a lower mean P&L than the same model-priced straddle on non-event days.

trial.statistic: Difference in mean MODEL-PRICED short-straddle P&L (event minus non-event), bootstrap CI; mean |r|/(GVZ/sqrt(252)) by group.
trial.null: Event-day mean P&L >= non-event mean P&L.
trial.procedure: Load GLD daily closes and the GVZ CSV; FOMC (Fed calendars) and CPI dates (hardcoded from BLS archives); stratify by GVZ tercile and by real-rate regime.
trial.data: GLD daily closes (free, not wired), Cboe GVZ history (free CSV, not in the current list), FOMC/CPI calendars.
trial.pass: Difference < 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Placebo dates; exclude 2020-03; compare with the SPX result.

strategies.blocked_on: GLD daily closes and GVZ history fetchers (both free) plus CPI calendar; runnable as soon as they are loaded.
strategies.harness_suggestion: Generalise the VIX-as-IV straddle harness to (underlying, vol index) pairs: (SPY,VIX), (GLD,GVZ), (BTC,DVOL), (QQQ,VXN), (USO,OVX).

strategies.name: Monthly opex gamma pin (short ATM straddle / iron butterfly on heavy-OI strikes)

legs.strike_rule: pin strike K: largest combined call+put OI within +/-1% of spot
legs.expiry_rule: third-Friday monthly expiry, entered Friday morning (0DTE) or the Thursday close

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: Straddle: Cr - |S_T - K|. Iron butterfly: Cr - min(|S_T - K|, w) with w = wing width.
strategies.max_profit: Cr at S_T = K.
strategies.max_loss: Straddle: unlimited upside, K - Cr downside. Iron butterfly: w - Cr.
strategies.breakevens: K - Cr and K + Cr.
strategies.when_to_use: Monthly opex when estimated dealer gamma is positive and a strike within +/-1% carries outsized OI; sell on that strike Friday morning, hold to the close. Avoid when GEX is negative or a macro release falls the same day.
strategies.risks: Pinning is a tendency: one trend day costs several credits; SPX monthlies are AM-settled from Friday opening prices (trading stops Thursday), so close pinning applies to SPXW PM, SPY and single names; OI-based dealer-gamma estimates assume customers are long calls/short puts, which fails with heavy overwriting.
strategies.margin_note: Naked short straddle margin for the no-wing version; iron butterfly margin = w - Cr. SPX/XSP Section 1256; SPY/stocks not.
strategies.crypto_notes: Deribit monthly expiry (last Friday of the month, 08:00 UTC) concentrates OI; see deribit-expiry-max-pain-pin.
strategies.metals_notes: COMEX gold options (OG) stop trading on the 4th-last business day of the month before the contract month (CME rule; cmegroup.com blocks plain fetches, verify there); round-strike gravitation is anecdotal. GLD monthly opex works like other equity options.
variants: Short strangle at the two heaviest-OI strikes bracketing spot
Thursday-close entry (adds overnight theta and gap risk)
strategies.claim: A 1-day ATM SPY short straddle model-priced with VIX-as-IV (sigma = VIX at Thursday's close, T = 1/252), sold at Thursday's close and settled at Friday's close, has a higher mean P&L when that Friday is a monthly third-Friday expiration than on other Fridays.

trial.statistic: Difference in mean MODEL-PRICED short-straddle P&L (opex Fridays minus other Fridays), bootstrap CI; secondary: distance of SPY close to nearest $1 strike, opex vs non-opex (permutation test).
trial.null: Opex-Friday mean P&L <= other-Friday mean P&L.
trial.procedure: Third Fridays since 1993; SPY closes; VIX; settle on |SPY_Fri - SPY_Thu|; compare groups. The open-to-close version and OI/GEX conditioning need OHLC and chain captures.
trial.data: SPY daily closes since 1993, VIX; later chain OI captures.
trial.pass: Difference > 0 with 95% CI excluding 0.
trial.controls: Exclude opex days with FOMC/CPI; quarterly vs non-quarterly opex; pre/post-2010 split.

strategies.harness_suggestion: GEX estimator (sum over strikes of OI*gamma*S^2*0.01, calls +, puts -) once chain captures accumulate; join to the opex test.

strategies.name: Options-implied digital vs event contract (call spread vs Kalshi/Polymarket)

legs.strike_rule: K (the event contract's threshold); scale 1/w spreads per $1 binary
legs.expiry_rule: expiry matching the event contract's resolution time (SPXW PM for 'S&P closes above K')

legs.strike_rule: K + w (w = smallest strike increment, e.g. 5 SPX points)

strategies.payoff_at_expiry: min(max(S-K,0), w) - D per spread; divided by w it approximates the binary 1{S_T > K}. Paired with selling the event contract's YES (or buying NO) when the spread is cheaper.
strategies.max_profit: w - D per spread (S_T >= K+w).
strategies.max_loss: D per spread (S_T <= K).
strategies.breakevens: K + D.

greeks_at_inception.gamma: positive below K, negative above (sign depends on spot vs K)
greeks_at_inception.theta: negative if OTM, positive if ITM
greeks_at_inception.vega: positive if OTM, negative if ITM

strategies.when_to_use: When a Kalshi/Polymarket contract on an index/asset level at a date diverges from the options-implied digital (call-spread mid / w) by more than combined fees and spreads. Exact settlement matching matters (SPX 4pm close vs the contract's resolution source).
strategies.risks: Settlement-source mismatch (index vs ETF, time of day); the call spread approximates the digital only to within w; event-contract liquidity and fees; Polymarket is not available to US persons; capital lockup on both venues.
strategies.margin_note: Call spread debit; event contracts fully collateralised. SPX Section 1256; event-contract tax treatment differs.
strategies.crypto_notes: Polymarket 'BTC above X on date' vs Deribit call-spread digitals; Deribit settles at 08:00 UTC on a 30-minute index average, which rarely matches the event contract's source, so basis risk must be modelled.
strategies.metals_notes: Kalshi gold-price contracts vs GLD/GC call-spread digitals; GC settles on the CME settlement price.
variants: Buy cheap digital / sell dear event contract
strategies.claim: Whenever the gap between an S&P 500 event-contract YES price and the SPXW call-spread-implied digital exceeds round-trip costs at a daily snapshot, the convergence trade (buy cheap side, sell dear side, hold to settlement) has a positive mean P&L.

trial.statistic: Mean P&L per $1 notional with bootstrap CI; frequency of tradable gaps.
trial.procedure: Aligned daily snapshots of SPXW chains and Kalshi/Polymarket index contracts; compute digital = (C(K)-C(K+w))/w at mids and executable sides; trade when the executable gap > costs; settle both.
trial.data: SPXW chain captures from 2026-10-14; Polymarket/Kalshi event-contract data (reachable).
